POST /accounts/{account_id}/dlp/validato.description:
Creates a reusable list of weighted words that detection entries can attach to in order to
refine their matches. An account may own at most 100 validators across all kinds.

schema.description:
The attributes of a proximity word validator.

A write replaces both fields in full, so `PUT` must send the complete word list, not just the
words that changed. The computed fields a `GET` returns (`id`, `kind`, `referenced_by`,
`created_at`, `updated_at`) are ignored if sent, so a response can be edited and submitted back
as-is.

name.description: A name for this validator, at most 50 characters.

words.description:
The words that raise confidence when found near a match, at most 100 per validator. Matching
ignores case, so the list may not contain the same word twice with different capitalisation.
Words are stored as sent.

For example, a validator for medical record numbers might use
`[{"word": "patient", "weight": "strong"}, {"word": "diagnosis", "weight": "moderate"},
{"word": "mrn", "weight": "weak"}]`.

items.description: A word that raises a match's confidence when it appears near the match.

weight.description:
How much a word contributes to a match's confidence when it is found nearby.

Separate from a profile's high/medium/low confidence threshold: this describes how telling the
word is, not how confident the resulting match is.

word.description:
The word or phrase to look for. Must contain 1–128 characters and is matched
case-insensitively.
